name: Durak
summary: Russia's most popular shedding card game where players attack and defend, last with cards is the Fool.
rules_text: Use 36 cards (6-A). Shuffle and deal 6 each. Turn bottom card face up to set trump suit; it stays as last draw card. Lowest trump attacks first. Attacker plays a card face up. Defender left of attacker must beat it with higher same suit or any trump. If beat, other players clockwise may add new attack cards matching any rank already on table, up to 6 total attacks. Original attacker has priority to add, then clockwise non-defenders. Defender must beat each new card. If defender beats all and no one adds, all table cards go to discard and defender becomes next attacker. If defender fails, they take entire table into hand. Others may then add matching ranks for defender to also take, up to 6. Next attacker is left of defender. After each bout, players draw to 6: main attacker first, then other attackers clockwise, then defender. When talon empty, players out of cards are eliminated. Last player with cards is durak, loser.
rating_reason: Popular shedding defender-attacker game, hidden hands, strategic.
